state:
Goal `core-session`, stage 2. `Core\Session::clear` has all its feature proofs: about, three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure, a Rust test and its card. `Core\Session` now has a class card, and is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. The other eight members still owe examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `covers:` test.

Every Session proof needs a real store and a real request. The shape is on disk under `docs/examples/core/Session/clear/`: an `nvs.toml` in the feature directory that grants `[capabilities.cache] shared`, sets `[session] backend = "shared"` and `[cache.shared] url = "redis://127.0.0.1:16379"`, and a `.nvsr` beside each program. `tests/hostile/core/Session/clear/` has the same pair. `benches/members/core/Session/nvs.toml` already serves every Session bench, so a new bench needs only its own `.nvsr`. Redis is `tests/db/compose.yaml`'s service, which the goal's `env.docker` brings up.

A bench's figure goes stale whenever `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/session.rs` changes. Any slice that edits that file re-owes the perf of every Session member already measured, `clear` included. Run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --id '<member>'` for each of them after the last Rust edit.

Then re-record `clear`'s perf.
